crop.notes: Report of the St. Louis Farmers' Club debate on agricultural fairs; the club headline and subhead at the top are cut off. Allen is mentioned only in the 'Prize-Fighting' section (crop-3). The bottom of crop-3 and all of crop-4 are an unrelated letter, 'The Future Great City - Reavis' Great Work'.

ocr.notes: The gist is readable, with many garbled words. The Allen paragraph is mostly right ('Mile McCoole' for Mike McCoole).

summary.suggested: The Missouri Republican reported that at a St. Louis Farmers' Club debate on agricultural fairs, Dr. Morse said a $1,000 premium might bring Tom Allen, Mike McCoole or another famous pugilist to stage a prize fight.

metadata.notes: The masthead reads 'The Missouri Republican--St. Louis, August 22, 1870'.

notes: This is only a passing hypothetical mention of Allen as a famous pugilist, so no facts were extracted.
